proves.claim: The coordinator clearReviewReservation clears only the submitted item review reservation, ends its review-job lease through the review lease port, leaves the item submitted and lets another reviewer reserve it.

store.review-lease.coordinator-clear.why: A held review reservation is item_review_by and item_review_until, which the build-route clearReservation never touched, so a stuck review had no coordinator clear.

proves.claim: A non-coordinator clearReviewReservation is refused COORDINATOR_ONLY with no mutation, and an item holding only a build-route reservation is refused and left unchanged.

store.review-lease.coordinator-clear-ref.why: Only the coordinator may take a review away from its reviewer, and the clear must never reach a build-route reservation.
